messages.subject: [VOTE] July 2026 PR of the Month
messages.body:
Hey All,

It's once again time to vote for the PR of the Month!

With the help of the get_important_pr_candidates script in dev/stats, we've
identified the following candidates:

PR#69915: Split airflowctl dags state argument into run_id and
--logical-date by @FrankYang0529 (PoAn Yang)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/69915

PR#69830: Read fresh Dag bundle state during refresh by @fat-catTW (Vincent
Hsiao)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/69830

PR#70261: Resolve nested provider paths for conn-fields check from the real
directory tree by @Lee-W (Wei Lee)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70261

PR#67848: Log check_query_output response via format string in Snowflake
SQL API hook by @michaelneely
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/67848

PR#70291: Add support for operators that achieve durable execution manually
in registry by @amoghrajesh (Amogh Desai)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70291

Please reply to this thread with your selection or offer your own
nominee(s). Voting will close next Friday July 31st at 10 AM PST. The
winner(s) will be featured in the next issue of the Airflow newsletter.

Also, if there's an article or event you think should be included in this
or a future issue of the newsletter, please drop me a line at
briana.okyere@astronomer.io.

- Briana Steel

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] July 2026 PR of the Month
messages.body:
Hey All,

Yuseok noticed an issue with this month's PR of the month- the script chose
the top PRs from a specific day (the 24th), not the entire month.

Thank you Yuseok for the catch! With that, here are the actual top PR's
from this month. My apologies to anyone on the previous list for the
misunderstanding.

PR#68479: Add Vertex AI Agent Engine operators (Create, Get, Query, Update,
Delete)
by @AlejandroMorgante (Alejandro Morgante)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/68479

PR#61550: Add the option to select bundle version parameter on dag run
trigger endpoint
by @itayweb (Itay Adler)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/61550

PR#64745: Fix batchoperator deferrable xcom links
by @kakatur (Krishna Kakatur)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64745

PR#67725: Type asset_expression in the REST API so the UI does not cast
through unknown
by @Anuragp22 (Anurag Pappula)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/67725

PR#69295: Add airflow-ts-pack bundle build tool for TypeScript SDK
by @guan404ming (Guan-Ming Chiu)
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/69295

Please reply to this thread with your selection or offer your own
nominee(s). Voting will close next Friday July 31st at 10 AM PST. The
winner(s) will be featured in the next issue of the Airflow newsletter.
